player_intent: Use recovered SOCOM II Desert Glory assets and enhance their textures without redesigning the map.
acceptance_rule: Separate local saved map retains 10 source sectors, original UVs, 13217 structural triangles and 95 supported static source placements. No replacement props. One hashed AI wall override; unsupported source data remains deferred. Existing map and protected gameplay owners remain unchanged.

nodes.role: Selects saved map document then enters canonical main

must_not_change: Previously installed map and active map
visual_check: Run source variant through main; inspect original UV registration, wall enhancement, source props, clear spawns and single grain owner. No claim of exact source lighting or complete map recovery.

system_delta.reason: User changed art direction from substitute materials/props to source assets. Add explicit source variant and keep old map. Bounds failures are deferred, not forced through. AI wall enhancement remains a versioned local-only derivative.

candidate.system: Original UV/material variant plus validated source props and AI wall detail
